lines.t: Dust to dust, but something remains
Through the fire, through the rain
Listen...
Long after the glory of men fades out
And the rise of their kingdoms falls to the ground
When the towers they built are nowhere found
There’s a love still echoing, still resounding
When the crowns all rust and the names erased
And the pride of power is stripped away
There’s a whisper moving through time and space
Saying
Love still stands, it won’t decay
Yeah it don’t break…
Don’t bend…
Don’t end…
Through the fall, it remains
Long after it all turns to dust and disappears
That love still endures through the ages and years
When the stars burn out and the sky goes black
That love’s still alive, never fading back
Deeper than time, wider than space
You can’t outrun it, you can’t replace
Through forever and always, it stays the same
That enduring love—won’t fade away
Long after the stars in the heavens fall
And the night goes silent, no light at all
When the universe dims and the echoes stall
That love’s still reaching beyond it all
It’s deeper than oceans we’ve never seen
Runs through forever, unseen,
Every moment lost and every in-between
Still holding strong like it’s always been
Yeah it don’t break…
Don’t bend…
Don’t end…
Through the fall, it remains
Long after it all turns to dust and disappears
That love still endures through the ages and years
When the stars burn out and the sky goes black
That love’s still alive, never fading back
Deeper than time, wider than space
You can’t outrun it, you can’t replace
Through forever and always, it stays the same
That enduring love—won’t fade away
Before the world spun into motion
Before the sky, before the ocean
There was a promise set in place
A love no end could ever erase
And after the last breath this world will take
After the final line we break
That love won’t leave, it won’t be gone
It carries on and on and on
And there’s a call through the ages clear
“You belong, come draw near”
A bond unbroken, a sacred claim
A people marked by enduring flame
Endures…
Endures…
That love endures…
Endures…
Endures…
Forever it endures…
Through every rise and every fall
Through the silence after it all
There’s a love that still remains
Calling every heart by name
